name: toggle
description: Things switched on and off by a button: a map, an inventory, a torch, a list of quests, a second view, the pause of the game. A Toggle is flipped by its action; the entities that follow it are shown only while it is on (or only while it is off), or work only then.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Flips on each time the action is pressed (and with hold, is on only while the action is held); off (an action, none when left out) only switches it off: the Resume or Close button of a menu. times counts the times it was switched on, for a rule or a test. With pauses, the game is paused while it is on (app Time paused): the simulation stops, except what runs while paused (menus, phases, a change of scene), and while paused only the Toggles that pause react to their actions. A pause menu is then an entity with ShownBy this Toggle.

components.name: ShownBy
components.description: The entity is shown (it has no transform2d.Hidden) only while the Toggle of the entity that answers to toggle (a tag.Tag) is on, or with inverse only while it is off.

components.name: ActiveBy
components.description: The entity works (it has no transform2d.Disabled) only while the Toggle of the entity that answers to toggle is on, or with inverse only while it is off: a character frozen while a menu is open, or while it lies dead.

systems.name: flip
systems.description: Flips every Toggle whose action is pressed, pauses the game while a Toggle that pauses is on, then shows and hides, switches on and off, what follows them.
